{
  "dataset_name": "phoneme",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "l2_norm_from_global_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance of the row from the training-set global mean vector, normalized by the average feature standard deviation. Captures how far a point is from the center of the feature space.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a scale-normalized distance to the global centroid, improving neighborhood geometry by anchoring relative distances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((V1 - 0.8383) ** 2 + (V2 - 1.2733) ** 2 + (V3 - 0.7269) ** 2 + (V4 - 0.3907) ** 2 + (V5 - 0.0973) ** 2)) / 0.8288"
    },
    {
      "name": "zscore_v1",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalization of V1 using training-set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes V1 to unit scale, reducing distance distortion caused by differing feature magnitudes in KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 - 0.8383) / 0.8822"
    },
    {
      "name": "zscore_v2",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalization of V2 using training-set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-2.9, 2.6],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes V2 to unit scale, reducing distance distortion in KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V2 - 1.2733) / 0.8757"
    },
    {
      "name": "zscore_v3",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalization of V3 using training-set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-2.1, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes V3 to unit scale, reducing distance distortion in KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V3 - 0.7269) / 0.9249"
    },
    {
      "name": "zscore_v4",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalization of V4 using training-set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-2.1, 2.6],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes V4 to unit scale, reducing distance distortion in KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V4 - 0.3907) / 0.7835"
    },
    {
      "name": "zscore_v5",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalization of V5 using training-set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-2.1, 3.9],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes V5 to unit scale, reducing distance distortion in KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V5 - 0.0973) / 0.5879"
    },
    {
      "name": "feature_range_spread",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between the maximum and minimum z-scored feature values within a row, measuring intra-row feature spread.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Rows with high spread may occupy different regions of feature space; helps KNN distinguish compact vs. dispersed feature profiles.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum((V1 - 0.8383) / 0.8822, (V2 - 1.2733) / 0.8757), (V3 - 0.7269) / 0.9249), (V4 - 0.3907) / 0.7835), (V5 - 0.0973) / 0.5879) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum((V1 - 0.8383) / 0.8822, (V2 - 1.2733) / 0.8757), (V3 - 0.7269) / 0.9249), (V4 - 0.3907) / 0.7835), (V5 - 0.0973) / 0.5879)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cosine_similarity_to_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Cosine similarity between the row vector and the training-set mean vector, measuring directional alignment with the centroid.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures angular proximity to the centroid, complementing Euclidean distance for KNN neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 * 0.8383 + V2 * 1.2733 + V3 * 0.7269 + V4 * 0.3907 + V5 * 0.0973) / (np.sqrt(V1 ** 2 + V2 ** 2 + V3 ** 2 + V4 ** 2 + V5 ** 2) * np.sqrt(0.8383 ** 2 + 1.2733 ** 2 + 0.7269 ** 2 + 0.3907 ** 2 + 0.0973 ** 2) + 1e-9)"
    },
    {
      "name": "low_frequency_energy_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of squared sum of V1 and V2 (lower-index features) to total squared feature energy, capturing relative energy concentration in early features.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes spectral energy distribution pattern; rows with similar ratios cluster together in KNN, improving neighborhood coherence.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 ** 2 + V2 ** 2) / (V1 ** 2 + V2 ** 2 + V3 ** 2 + V4 ** 2 + V5 ** 2 + 1e-9)"
    },
    {
      "name": "feature_monotonicity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of sign-consistent decrements across consecutive z-scored features, measuring how monotonically decreasing the feature profile is.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Rows with similar monotonicity patterns tend to cluster together; helps KNN identify structurally similar feature profiles.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((V2 - 1.2733) / 0.8757 < (V1 - 0.8383) / 0.8822, 1.0, -1.0) + np.where((V3 - 0.7269) / 0.9249 < (V2 - 1.2733) / 0.8757, 1.0, -1.0) + np.where((V4 - 0.3907) / 0.7835 < (V3 - 0.7269) / 0.9249, 1.0, -1.0) + np.where((V5 - 0.0973) / 0.5879 < (V4 - 0.3907) / 0.7835, 1.0, -1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_energy_outlier_indicator",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of whether the row has unusually high total feature energy (L2 norm from origin) compared to typical training samples, scored 0 to 1 where higher means more outlier-like.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Identifies high-energy outlier rows that may form sparse neighborhoods in KNN, allowing the model to weight such points differently.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "feature_profile_smoothness",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how smoothly the z-scored feature values transition across V1 to V5, scored 0 (highly irregular) to 1 (very smooth/gradual transitions), based on average absolute consecutive difference.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth feature profiles may correspond to distinct phoneme types; helps KNN group rows with similar spectral envelope shapes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
